name: System Shell
description: Generic command-line capability: file system navigation, text processing, process inspection, and Unix tooling for creative self-directed problem solving.
author: architect-prime
when_to_use: When a task needs general-purpose shell work — inspecting the filesystem, processing text/JSON/logs, chaining Unix tools, checking processes or services — rather than a specific CoreKit script. This is the default capability for open-ended system tasks.
